claims.statement: The deceased woman worked at the Irkutsk infectious-disease research institute.
The death of the laboratory worker was publicly reported.
Russian authorities publicly described the illness as pneumonia of unknown etiology or origin.
Pneumonic plague was established as the diagnosis.
The illness or death was established as linked to a pathogen handled at work.
Authorities reported that contacts were identified and monitored.
A dangerous infectious-disease pathogen was established among monitored contacts.
A second plague case was established.
A second death connected to the suspected plague event was established.
WHO published an initial, provisional risk assessment for this event.
